summary: Owner refined RC car requirement: Android control over Wi-Fi or 5G mobile Internet, not Bluetooth. Recommended ESP32 as primary controller; for Wi-Fi coverage car uses 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and phone may access via 5G through authenticated MQTT/WebSocket cloud; for operation outside Wi-Fi, add 4G LTE SIM7600 cellular development board, SIM/data, antenna, suitable power, while phone can remain on 5G. 4G is sufficient for driving commands; true 5G car modem not needed. Common drivetrain: TB6612FNG subject to stall current, 2 TT motors, 2WD chassis, battery power, wire/switch. Mandatory watchdog stops vehicle on command timeout and use secure channel. Pending question: Wi-Fi zone only or vehicle mobile outside Wi-Fi?
